name: oauth
description: OAuth 2.0 authentication on the v4 substrate — pluggable provider adapters, Drizzle-backed token storage, Hono routes. State lives in the URL `state` param; tokens persist in DB; no express-session.
postInstall: Add the schema to your composed schema: `createApp({ schema: { ...accountsSchema, oauthConnections, oauthConnectionsRelations } })`
Wire the routes: `defineOAuthRoutes(app, { service, provider, adapters })`
Configure OAuth credentials in .env for the providers you support
